items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I was appearing at the Village Vanguard... a friend of mine came and said, 'I want to take you uptown to hear the new music.' And it was -- Dizzy was at the Royal Roost... I like to feel that there are certain areas where the one thing evolves into the other... although Dizzy Gillespie is identified

ctx.x: You had the traditionalists against the beboppers and the modernists --

Well, way back, I would say around 1956, before I eventually retired, I was appearing at the Village Vanguard down in the Village; and a friend of mine came and said, 'I want to take you uptown to hear the new music.'
